_startCommandOverride: Set this as the service's Custom Start Command in Railway (Settings -> Deploy). The shared backend/railway.json intentionally sets NO startCommand (config-as-code would otherwise override this dashboard value and force the scheduler to run the API).
_liveness: Celery beat is not an HTTP service; Railway healthchecks do not apply. Relies on the ON_FAILURE restart policy.
_scaling: MUST run exactly ONE replica. Multiple celery-beat instances duplicate every scheduled firing (campaigns scheduler_tick, assignments expire_stale_locks, analytics aggregate_daily_metrics). Do not enable horizontal scaling on this service.
